lines.speaker: mattie_tolliver
lines.text: Green pennant's up. Means the door's open at night, if anyone's walking. My grandmother's rule, not mine.

lines.speaker: mattie_tolliver
lines.text: Boarded it from the inside. Don't know why. You board a thing up when you think you're coming back to it.

lines.speaker: mattie_tolliver
lines.text: Ovens are lit. Come back at four if you want to see the only hour of the day that belongs to anybody.
